name: wp-theme/cilla-skyn-sticky-banner
title: Cilla Skyn Sticky Banner
description: Full-bleed banner that pins in place (position: sticky) for a stretch of scroll before releasing, marking a deliberate break between the sections before and after it. Same optional fields as Cilla Skyn Banner (background image with fit/focal point, overlay, text colour, eyebrow, heading, two rich-text paragraphs, tagline), plus a Pin Duration control.
